'''''Number Four''''' was an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] used by the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was later used by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] against the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Myrkr Base|base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]]. It was under command of an [[Unidentified AT-AT commander|unnamed officer]], and ultimately, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Freja Covell|Covell]]. It worked alongside other AT-ATs, including the [[Number Two (AT-AT)|''Number Two'']], as well as repulsorlift tanks and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]].
